title: Channels, Team Chat & Mention Notifications
description: Navigate Teams channels, send rich chat messages, @mention colleagues, and manage notification feeds.
objectives: Understand Teams, Channels, and Direct Chat messaging
Format messages, post announcements, and send attachments
Use @mentions to notify specific team members

steps.title: Team Communication Hub
steps.content: Teams replaces cluttered internal email chains with organized Channel conversations and direct chat messaging.

quiz.question: What happens when you type '@username' inside a Teams Channel conversation?
options: It triggers an immediate priority notification to that specific team member
quiz.explanation: @mentions send direct activity notifications to specified users in Microsoft Teams.

title: Video Meetings, Screen Sharing & Backgrounds
description: Host video meetings, share presentation screens, mute microphones, and apply custom background blur.
objectives: Start instant 'Meet Now' or scheduled video calls
Share specific application windows or full screen desktop
Apply background blur and custom virtual backgrounds

steps.title: Video Collaboration & Sharing
steps.content: Teams video meetings support screen sharing, live closed captions, digital hand raising, and breakout rooms.

quiz.question: Which option allows you to share only your PowerPoint presentation window without revealing your personal desktop background?
quiz.explanation: Sharing a specific Window hides your desktop background and private desktop applications.

title: File Co-authoring, Tab Apps & Channel Bots Pro
description: Pin Excel/Word tab apps inside channels, co-author documents, and automate workflows with Channel Bots.
objectives: Add custom Tab Apps (Excel, SharePoint, Planner) to channels
Co-author documents directly inside Teams windows

steps.title: Extending Teams with Apps
steps.content: Teams tabs pin key Excel spreadsheets, Planner taskboards, or OneNote notebooks directly to channel headers for instant team access.

quiz.question: How can you pin an Excel tracker spreadsheet directly to a Channel header bar for easy access?
options: Click the '+' icon in the Channel header and select the Excel Tab App
quiz.explanation: The '+' tab button pins key cloud files and web apps directly to Channel headers.
